gt.desc:
AiDiglet is a Telegram Mini App where players mine $DIGS by tapping — a Notcoin-era onboarding loop retrofitted for a graduated pump.fun token.

Utility: every in-game $DIGS balance is bridgeable to the $DIGS SPL token via admin-signed Phantom payouts. Players burn in-game supply on the TON side to mint SPL on Solana at a floating peg (total in-game supply ≈ $200 USD worth of SPL at live pump.fun
Vicewire is a custom build of GTA VI for PC. real SOL powers the in-game economy, and payments settle on-chain.
